settings.home_grid_heading: Everything for the *rural, trade and handyman* job
settings.home_grid_text: From a box of tek screws to a trailer-load of RHS, Teqco supplies the gear for farm work, trade jobs, workshops and projects around the home.
settings.home_quote_text: Not sure where to start, or looking for something a little different? Give us a call or send through an enquiry. We'll let you know what we have in store and whether we can help source it.

home_facts.b: Get an early start with us. We're open Monday to Friday, 7am–5pm.
Need a particular length? Ask us about steel cutting and sheet metal folding up to 3mm.
Find us on the corner of Bathurst and Denison Streets. Drop in and have a chat with the team.

settings.home_about_heading: Local knowledge. *A good stock.* Friendly service.
settings.home_about_text:
Teqco supplies steel, tools, hardware and much more to farmers, tradies and locals across the district.

Formerly CS Steel, Teqco continues to provide a broad range of products and practical services for jobs on the farm, at work and around the home. Pop in, tell us what you're working on and we'll do our best to point you in the right direction.

home_about_points.a: A wide stock under one roof
home_about_points.b: Steel, tools, fasteners, hardware and everyday essentials for work and around the property.
Friendly service to help you find the right gear for the job.
Your local supplier for rural, trade and home projects.

settings.home_contact_heading: Got a question? Give us a call.
settings.home_contact_text: Product range, sizes or a quote for a cut. Call, drop in, or send an enquiry and we will get back to you as soon as we can.
settings.about_hero_title: Local know-how. The gear to get the job done.
settings.about_hero_text: Your local stop for steel, tools, hardware and rural supplies in Condobolin. Whether you’re working on the farm, on the tools or tackling a job at home, we’re here to help you find what you need.
settings.about_story_heading: A local name for the *jobs that matter*
settings.about_story_text:
Teqco supplies farmers, tradespeople and handymen across Condobolin and surrounding district with the steel, tools and hardware they need to get the job done.

Previously CS Steel, Teqco continues to supply a wide range of steel sections, sheet metal, mesh, hand and power tools, fasteners and general hardware. With practical advice and friendly service, we’re here to help you find the right gear for the job, big or small.

about_services.title: Steel supply
about_services.text: From RHS and SHS to pipe, angle, flat bar, sheet metal, mesh and roofing, we stock a wide stock of steel products for farm, building and workshop projects. Cut-to-length options are available on selected products.

about_services.title: Cutting and folding
about_services.text: Need sheet metal cut or folded to size? We offer in-store guillotine cutting and folding for sheet metal up to 3mm thick. Get in touch to discuss your measurements and requirements.

about_services.title: Tools and hardware
about_services.text: From hand and power tools to fasteners, fittings and everyday hardware, we carry the essentials for the workshop, the job site and around the property.

settings.about_cta_text:
You’ll find us on the corner of Bathurst and Denison Streets in Condobolin. Pop in, have a chat with the team and pick up what you need for the next job.

Can't make it in? Give us a call or send through an enquiry and we'll be happy to help.
settings.products_hero_title: A whole lot for the job at hand
settings.products_hero_text: From a box of tek screws to a trailer load of RHS, you'll find a good range of supplies for the farm, the workshop and jobs around the home. Browse our ranges below, or give us a call if you're after something in particular.
settings.products_catalogues_text: Browse the full ranges from some of the brands we stock. Catalogues open on the supplier's website.
settings.products_cta_text: If we don't have it on the shelf, we can usually source it. Call us or send an enquiry with sizes and quantities and we will come back with a price.
settings.contact_hero_title: Got a question? Give us a call.
settings.contact_hero_text: Need help with our products, sizes or a quote? Whether you’re planning a job or looking for the right materials, give us a call, drop into the store or send us an enquiry. We’re happy to help.
settings.contact_text: For a quick answer, give us a call or pop into the store. If you need a quote, send through your sizes and quantities using the form below, and we’ll get back to you as soon as we can.
settings.contact_map_text: 14-22 Bathurst Street, on the corner of Bathurst and Denison Streets.
settings.footer_blurb: Comprehensive retail outlet for the rural, trade and handyman market. Steel, tools, fasteners and hardware in Condobolin.
settings.seo_title: Teqco | Steel, Tools & Hardware Store in Condobolin NSW
settings.seo_description: Teqco is Condobolin’s steel, tools and hardware store. Steel cut to size, roofing and mesh, welding gear, power and hand tools, fasteners, gas, trailers, sheds and more for farm, trade and home.
home_about_paragraphs: Teqco supplies steel, tools, hardware and much more to farmers, tradies and locals across the district.

Formerly CS Steel, Teqco continues to provide a broad range of products and practical services for jobs on the farm, at work and around the home. Pop in, tell us what you're working on and we'll do our best to point you in the right direction.
about_story_paragraphs: Teqco supplies farmers, tradespeople and handymen across Condobolin and surrounding district with the steel, tools and hardware they need to get the job done.

Previously CS Steel, Teqco continues to supply a wide range of steel sections, sheet metal, mesh, hand and power tools, fasteners and general hardware. With practical advice and friendly service, we’re here to help you find the right gear for the job, big or small.

ranges.title: Steel, Roofing, Mesh
ranges.subtitle: Steeline, Lysaght, Arc Metalcentre, Steel Supplies
ranges.description: Teqco is your local supplier for steel, roofing and reinforcing products, stocking a large range of RHS, pipe, flat bar, angle and rod, along with reinforcing mesh and accessories. We supply metal roofing in Zincalume and Colorbond, cut to length, as well as Colorbond and pool fencing. We also stock a wide range of sheet metal, with cutting and folding capabilities up to 3mm.

image.alt: Steel coils chained on a flatbed truck

ranges.title: Welding Equipment & Power Tools
ranges.subtitle: Weldclass, HiKoki, Metabo
ranges.description: Teqco stocks MIG, stick and TIG welders, plasma cutters, grinders, drills, cut-off saws and cordless tools. We also carry welding rods, wire and a wide range of welding consumables to keep you working.

image.alt: Welder at work in a helmet

ranges.title: A-teq Trailers
ranges.subtitle: Flat-Top Tipping Trailers
ranges.description: Teqco is an agent for A-Teq Trailers, built tough for farm, trade and everyday work. Fully galvanised and rated to 3.5 tonnes, the range is available in various sizes, with tipping options also available.

ranges.title: Industrial & Domestic Gas
ranges.subtitle: Speed Gas, Origin
ranges.description: Teqco is your local agent for Origin Energy LPG and Speedgas, supplying gas bottle exchange for homes, farms, businesses and workshops. From LPG for the property to welding gases for the workshop, we offer a range of cylinder and exchange options with no ongoing cylinder rental charges. Talk to our team to find the right option for your needs.

ranges.title: Abrasives & Fasteners
ranges.subtitle: Addler, AllFasteners, Specfast
ranges.description: Teqco stocks the largest range of fasteners in town, including metric and imperial bolts, threaded rod, masonry anchors, tek screws and more. We also stock quality cutting, grinding and flap discs to help you get the job done.

image.alt: Steel bolts and nuts close up

ranges.title: Grainline Augers
ranges.subtitle: Grain handling for harvest
ranges.description: Teqco stocks grain augers and spare parts for harvest, including flighting, gearboxes, belts and drive components. Talk to us early in the season so we can help make sure the parts you need are on the shelf when harvest arrives.

ranges.title: Peerless Air Compressors
ranges.subtitle: Workshop and portable units
ranges.description: Teqco stocks a range of workshop and portable air compressors, from compact direct-drive units through to larger belt-drive workshop models. We also stock hoses, fittings, couplers and air tools to keep your compressed air setup working.

ranges.title: Atlantic Oils & Lubricants
ranges.subtitle: Engine, hydraulic and gear oils
ranges.description: We stock Atlantic engine, hydraulic, gear and transmission oils in 5L, 20L and 205L sizes, along with grease, coolants and workshop fluids for all makes of machinery. Not sure which product you need? We can match your machine with the correct lubricant in-store.

image.alt: Atlantic oil drum, pail and bulk container

ranges.title: Sheds
ranges.subtitle: Shedtech
ranges.description: Teqco supplies Shedtech kit sheds for the farm, workshop and home, including machinery sheds, garages, carports and hay sheds. We can help you choose the right size and provide a quote, then supply the complete shed kit and fixings ready for construction.

image.alt: Shedtech machinery and hay sheds on a farm at sunset

ranges.title: Polymaster Tanks
ranges.subtitle: Rainwater and stock tanks
ranges.description: Teqco stocks a range of poly tanks for rainwater, stock water and chemical storage, along with troughs to suit your property needs. We also stock outlets, fittings, float valves and pump connections to help complete your setup.

image.alt: Green poly water tank in a paddock

ranges.title: Garden Edging
ranges.subtitle: Teqedge
ranges.description: Teqco manufactures Teqedge Garden Edging, a cost-effective steel edging solution available in galvanised and weathering steel. Ideal for clean, straight lines, it can also be easily formed into curves to create a neat, low-maintenance garden edge.

image.alt: Curved steel garden edging along a lawn

ranges.title: Hand Tools
ranges.subtitle: KC Tools, Sheffield Group
ranges.description: Teqco stocks a great range of spanners, sockets, pliers, hammers, measuring tools, tool chests and tool rolls from KC Tools and the Sheffield Group. Trade-quality tools built to last.

image.alt: Hand tools on the Teqco store wall

ranges.title: Work Safety & Boots
ranges.subtitle: Maxisafe, Beaver
ranges.description: Teqco stocks a range of work safety gear, including steel cap and composite toe boots, gloves, hi-vis workwear, eye and ear protection, respiratory protection and first aid supplies.

image.alt: Work boots on a steel stair tread

ranges.title: Truck & Automotive Supplies
ranges.subtitle: Trailer parts, lights, mudflaps, other accessories
ranges.description: Our truck, trailer and automotive range includes trailer hubs and suspension components, lights, tow balls, ratchet tie-downs, mudflaps, oversize signage and more.

image.alt: Road train on an outback highway

ranges.title: General Merchandise
ranges.subtitle: Gate fittings, paint, pumps, chain, matting, castors
ranges.description: Teqco stocks a practical range of everyday hardware to keep your property running, including gate fittings from Rotech, trailer parts from Ark, industrial paint, Reefe pumps, chain and cable, rubber matting, wheels and castors from Allied Industrial, and Ultragrime wipes.
